scope: Three authored local repository tasks, not a research benchmark

tasks.description: Fix clamp so its returned numeric value is limited to the inclusive interval [lo, hi]. Inputs satisfy lo <= hi. Preserve values within the interval, return lo below it and hi above it. Preserve the exact function and parameter names.

Fix overlap_length to return the nonnegative length of intersection of two intervals. Each interval has start <= end. Disjoint or touching intervals have length zero. Preserve the exact function and parameter names.

Fix bucket_index to return an integer zero-based bucket index. Inputs satisfy value >= 0 and width > 0. Bucket k contains values from k*width inclusive to (k+1)*width exclusive. Use the supported numeric language profile; preserve the exact function and parameter names.
